description: Version bumps for everything pinned in golden-images. Checksums are recomputed by .github/workflows/checksums.yml on the PR branch.

customManagers.description: melange specs that carry a `# renovate:` hint above package/name/version (.NET, Go)
melange / apko versions in the toolchain image
crane (go-containerregistry) version in the toolchain image
Alpine branch (vX.Y) used by images and package build environments. node-22 is pinned to v3.22 on purpose.

packageRules.description: .NET 10 servicing (runtime + ASP.NET Core + SDK ship together on Patch Tuesday)
prBodyNotes: **Why:** Microsoft .NET 10 servicing release (usually includes security fixes). Our images use Microsoft's official linux-musl builds, so this lands the same week instead of waiting for Alpine.
Checksums are recomputed automatically by the `checksums` workflow; CI then builds and smoke-tests the .NET images.

packageRules.description: Go custom toolchain package stays on its minor; a new minor is a new image
prBodyNotes: **Why:** Go 1.27 patch release (security and bug fixes). Release notes: https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.27.minor
**Why:** keep the image build toolchain current. CI rebuilds every package and image with the new version before merge.

packageRules.description: Alpine stable branch bump touches every image: one grouped PR, never automerged
prBodyNotes: **Why:** a new Alpine stable branch is available. It brings newer package versions and longer security support. Release notes: https://alpinelinux.org/releases/
Every image is rebuilt and smoke-tested by CI. Check package version jumps (nodejs-current, python3, go) before merging.
